offerings.name: Tavily Search (basic, fast, ultra-fast)
offerings.pricing: basic, fast, ultra-fast: 1 API Credit; Pay-as-you-go: $0.008 per credit
offerings.free_quota: You get 1,000 free API Credits every month. No credit card required.
offerings.output_type: 按相关性排序的结构化搜索结果，含标题、来源 URL、内容；可选 LLM 生成答案和图片
offerings.note: 默认 search_depth=basic；最多返回20条结果；月付计划每credit为$0.0075-$0.005。

offerings.name: Tavily Search (advanced)
offerings.pricing: advanced: 2 API Credits; Pay-as-you-go: $0.008 per credit
offerings.free_quota: You get 1,000 free API Credits every month. No credit card required.
offerings.output_type: 按相关性排序的结构化搜索结果，含标题、来源 URL、多个相关片段；可选详细 LLM 答案
offerings.note: advanced为最高相关性、较高延迟；每来源可配置1至3个片段；最多返回20条结果。
